title: NBC News Creative & Digital Design Internships – Summer 2027
note: Paid 40-hour/week summer program with Artworks (on-air graphics) and Digital Art & Photo tracks; sophomores and up, Spring 2027 grads not eligible; may close early.

facts.summary: Ten-week paid summer internship on NBC News design teams in New York, across an on-air graphics track and a digital art and photo track.
facts.duties: Help produce daily graphics for broadcast; edit photos, build photo illustrations and make social graphics for NBC News, TODAY and MSNBC sites.
facts.requirements: Enrolled for the whole program, sophomore standing or higher (junior preferred); Adobe Suite, with Cinema 4D for the graphics track or strong Photoshop/Illustrator for digital; US work authorization without sponsorship.
facts.apply: Apply on NBCUniversal's SmartRecruiters page with a one-page resume, cover letter and unofficial transcript; window Nov 9 – Dec 4, 2026.
